propositions: The gate matches config field names globally across any object under src/rebar, so a field whose bare name is read on any unrelated config passes the gate even if never read on its own declaring class.
CodeHealthConfig.enabled had zero direct read sites but passed the gate because UiConfig.enabled and other same-named attributes elsewhere were read, making the bare name 'enabled' match globally.

A field is satisfied only when resolved to its owning dataclass, not when a same-named attribute exists on an unrelated object; the resolver must bind receiver expressions to candidate schema classes through annotations, section names, assignments, return types, and call sites.

Four fields were newly flagged after the fix (McpConfig.readonly, McpConfig.allow_llm, McpConfig.allow_jira_sync, JiraConfig.allow_insecure) and each was verified to be live; they are reported but not triaged per operator ruling.

Existing test files must be migrated to the owner-resolution contract; test_check_config_reads.py and test_check_config_reads_heldout.py are explicit edit targets that must become passing rather than worked around.
The fix must land with factual read-via markers for newly-flagged fields or be sequenced behind field resolutions; silent exemptions to keep CI green are forbidden.
